origin: ported from PS3/final_streamlit_app; fixed label-free rule (model=None) selected over a balanced logistic model that tied it; artifact sha256 22c3f537...a277; v2 adopted by scripts/model_search.py (artifacts/benchmark.json): hot-episode fraction ranks the true car first in all six cases, including case 04 where v1 ranked it second
rule: primary: fraction of valid cooling readings where the car is more than 2 degC above the median of the other cars (leak episodes); tie-break: mean excess over the other cars (the v1 rule)

validation.split: leave-one-case-out over the 6 labelled cases, all eight cars of a case held out together
validation.metric: linear rank decay (n - (r - 1)) / n, averaged over cases (ACV Info Kit Section 4)
validation.caveat: six cases and six rule variants: the margins in cases 04 and 05 and in the test file are a few tenths of a percent of readings, so the top pick on the test file is unchanged from v1 (Car 01) and only lower ranks move. Treat 1.0 as an upper bound.
